title: Lipoprotein(a), Endothelial Dysfunction and Cardiovascular Disease.

snippet: Lipoprotein(a) (Lp(a)) is a particle similar to low-density lipoprotein cholesterol and is associated with apolipoprotein (A). High Lp(a) levels are a genetic, independent risk factor for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD). title: Alterations in the Immune-Fibrotic Axis Are Spatially Localized in the Aging Heart.
snippet: The immune-fibrotic axis functions as a vicious feedback loop where age-related chronic, low-grade systemic inflammation (inflammaging) drives maladaptive tissue repair and fibrosis, while senescent fibrotic cells in turn amplify systemic inflammation.
